info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API allows users to access information regarding specific deposit lending products associated with savings accounts. By providing a unique parameter, clients can retrieve detailed insights, including product terms and conditions. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, developers, and third-party services seeking to enhance their offerings or provide customers with tailored lending options. Its straightforward design facilitates seamless integrations into banking applications and customer service platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific savings account, including balance, transaction history, and account terms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the specific savings account identified by the account number ACC-200045. It specifies the necessary parameters to ensure accurate and complete data retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the savings account details.
